Description.SourceString:
Infiltration has been successful. Disguise remains unbroken, observation continues without issue.  

Observation log: The expedition members are strange creatures. Already I have watched them flounder in the mud, grabbing containers of water that they need to boil to drink.

Question: Do they lack two-chamber stomachs? Can they not absorb the minerals in the water?

Rats appear to be their delicacy of choice, as explained to them by a large man that feels like he could crush me with his thick, firm, muscular, thighs. A terrible way to go. I should keep an eye on them… err, him… to make sure I do not suffer that terrible fate.

War has already been declared on the local goblin population. Each side slaughters one another with wild abandon, and then they pick from the remains to create the meagre weapons and armour that barely separates them from the local  wildlife.

Threat assessment: Harmless - From what I have seen so far, I cannot imagine they will make it past the draconic overlord of the area. Honestly, I would be surprised if they make it past a particularly surly sheep.

I will provide my next report further into these wildlands.

End of report.

- Agent Ravioli
